review_candidates.description: Mentee Robotics, now part of Mobileye, brings world-class robotics expertise, together with Mobileye's decades of leadership in computer vision, machine learning, and autonomous driving technologies. Building on that foundation, Mentee by Mobileye is creating the "MenteeBot", the AI-first humanoid robot that combines perception, reasoning, learning, and advanced dexterous manipulation, designed to work alongside people in their everyday lives, at the workplace and in the home. At Mobileye, our technologies power more than 230 million vehicles worldwide and have helped shape the future of autonomous mobility. With teams around the world, we continue to innovate at the forefront of autonomous systems, advancing the next generation of Physical AI for real life. Responsibilities Architect a Centralized Platform: Design and develop a comprehensive, multi-purpose application that serves as the central hub for the company's robotic operations, fleet management, and performance analytics. Develop Robot Control Interfaces: Build real-time control systems that allow engineers and operators to securely connect to the robots, visualize live sensory data, and directly command robot functionality via tele-operation. Cross-Functional Integration: Collaborate closely with our AI, simulation, and hardware teams to ensure seamless data flow and integration between the physical robots, backend infrastructure, and user interfaces. Requirements 5+ years of proven experience in backend software engineering and scalable system design. Deep proficiency in Python and a strong working knowledge of TypeScript . A proven track record of building robust APIs and successfully integrating complex software components (e.g., physics simulations, data collection, distributed systems). Solid experience designing and implementing asynchronous communication using message brokers and event streaming platforms (e.g., RabbitMQ, Kafka ). Extensive hands-on experience designing and managing both SQL and NoSQL databases. Specific experience with PostgreSQL, MongoDB and Redis is highly preferred. Hands-on experience implementing logging, monitoring, and alerting systems (e.g., Elastic Stack / ELK, Prometheus, Grafana ) to ensure the reliability and health of complex, distributed architectures. Advantages Experience building with agentic AI frameworks such as LangChain, CrewAI or PydanticAI . Hands-on experience with popular web frameworks like NestJS, Django, or FastAPI . Familiarity with robotics middleware and simulation environments, particularly ROS2 and Isaac Sim . Experience deploying, scaling, and managing applications on cloud platforms like AWS or GCP . Basic working knowledge of modern frontend frameworks (e.g., React, NextJS ) to occasionally build or maintain internal dashboards and tools.

With a strong reputation for excellence and a deep understanding of the industry, Hexwired Recruitment is committed to delivering tailored staffing solutions that meet the unique needs of both clients and candidates. Our extensive network and expertise enable us to identify top-tier talent for roles spanning software development, engineering, data science, cybersecurity, and more. We pride ourselves on fostering long-term relationships and ensuring a seamless hiring process that aligns with our clients' strategic goals. About The Role Hexwired Recruitment Limited is partnering with a market-leading technology company to hire talented Remote C++ Developers to join a high-performing, international engineering team tackling complex, real-world technical challenges. This role offers an exciting opportunity for candidates passionate about software development, algorithms, and optimization to contribute to innovative products that make a significant impact in their industry. As a remote team member, you will collaborate with global experts, work on cutting-edge projects, and develop solutions that require deep technical expertise and creative problem-solving skills. The position is ideal for individuals looking to advance their careers in a dynamic environment that values technical excellence, independent thinking, and continuous learning. Qualifications The ideal candidate will possess a strong foundation in C++ development, complemented by an academic background in Computer Science, Mathematics, Physics, or a related field. Proven experience in software engineering, particularly in algorithm design, optimization, and systems programming, is essential. Candidates should demonstrate a passion for tackling complex problems, an ability to think independently, and a creative approach to technical challenges. Excellent communication skills in English are required, as collaboration with international teams is a key aspect of the role. Familiarity with modern development tools, version control, and agile methodologies will be considered advantageous. Responsibilities As a C++ Developer, your responsibilities will include designing, developing, and maintaining high-quality software solutions that address complex technical problems. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand project requirements, contribute to the architecture and design of systems, and implement efficient, scalable code. Your role will involve optimizing algorithms for performance, ensuring code robustness, and participating in code reviews to uphold technical standards. Additionally, you will be involved in troubleshooting and debugging issues, documenting technical specifications, and continuously improving existing systems. Staying updated with the latest industry trends and best practices in C++ development and related technologies will be essential to drive innovation and maintain the company's competitive edge. Benefits This role offers a highly competitive salary package aligned with industry standards, reflecting the candidate's experience and expertise. The position is fully remote, providing flexibility to work from any location, and offers flexible working hours to promote a healthy work-life balance. You will have the opportunity to work on a stable, market-leading product alongside a world-class engineering team, gaining invaluable experience and exposure to cutting-edge technologies. The company fosters a culture of trust and innovation, encouraging engineers to share ideas and contribute to technical excellence. Additional benefits may include professional development opportunities, health insurance, and participation in industry events and training programs. Equal Opportunity Hexwired Recruitment Limited is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and applicants, regardless of race, gender, age, religion, sexual orientation, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws. We believe diversity enriches our workplace and drives innovation, and we actively promote a culture of respect, fairness, and equal opportunity in all our hiring practices and workplace policies.
